desc: The most items your kitchen can turn out at once, across all the categories you’ve ticked. Each category’s own batch size still applies on top.
example: Example: if you can cook 4 mains in 5 minutes, then set it to 4 items every 5 minutes. The total capacity limits orders across all selected categories so if you want to only sell a maximum of 10 starters and mains every 5 minutes, then set Total capacity to 10 items every 5 minutes and tick the Starters and Mains boxes. This will still keep your mains restricted to 4 items every 5 minutes.
noLimit: Leave at the infinity symbol for no limit.
warning: ⚠️ For kitchen capacity to work properly, set a prep time and batch size on your menu categories (Menu & Stock). Without them, capacity can’t tell how long items take to cook.
noVan: Add a van in Settings › Truck settings to set your kitchen capacity.
lead: How many items your kitchen can make, so customers can only pick collection times you can meet.
sameForAll: Same kitchen capacity for all vans?
confirmBody: All vans will use {van}’s kitchen capacity. Each van’s own numbers will be replaced.
colCountsTitle: Which categories count toward the total capacity. Cooked categories always count; tick instant ones (sides, dips, drinks) to include them.
countsLocked: Cooked — always counts (its prep & batch set the pace)
countsNoCap: Set a capacity to choose which categories count
countsUnavailable: Unavailable until the database is updated
countsTick: Tick to include this instant category (sides, dips, drinks) in the shared per-window limit
setCapacityFirst: Set a capacity to choose which categories count.
categoryBatchAria: {hasCategory, select, yes {{category} items per batch} other {items per batch}}
categoryPrepAria: {hasCategory, select, yes {{category} prep time} other {prep time}}
prepPerOrderHelp: How long one order takes to prepare
itemsAtATimeHelp: How many items your kitchen can cook simultaneously
instantNote: Instant items don’t count towards kitchen capacity — customers receive them immediately.
